description: NIST's CTC-05, its AP242 edition 1's solid #1205: the same edge as blend/nist-ctc-05-ap203-nurbs-torus-fillet, the B-spline face f109 written as one rational Bézier patch (1 × 1 spans) and the edge's curve as a cubic B-spline of 11 spans (no circle, off the best by 1.6e-3), against the torus f111, filleted alone at the battery's radius 0.889. The edge's tolerance is 2.4e-4 and its vertices' 2.1e-2. At v80 (AP203's v84) the faces turn tangent, a vanishing end; the offsets' section passes 2.6e-2 from the ball pinned there, which the vertex's tolerance admits and the edge's alone did not (ADR-0062, step 10a). The exact ball's arc there is 5.5e-4 wide and 2.5e-2 from the vertex, past its tolerance: no pole, so Arris refuses it TangentChain naming e256 and v80, as it does the AP203 edition. Open CASCADE builds a body BRepCheck_Analyzer finds invalid, 29 mm³ larger than the unfilleted part where a convex fillet removes about 2; its measures stay as the record and hold nothing (plans/nurbs-face-blend steps 1, 10a)
